subject: Novamed: Compliance posture & private deployment qualification
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire.park@novamed.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Private deploy options & compliance questions

Thanks again for the time today — helpful conversation. A few follow-ups from our side as we kick the internal procurement and security review: 

- Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 scope and last assessment date (Type II preferred)?
- Are you able to support HIPAA-covered workloads and provide a BAA?
- For GDPR: do you offer data residency guarantees per region and data processing agreements?
- We'd like to start the vendor security questionnaire — I've attached our initial RFI (Novamed_Security_RFI_v1.xlsx).

On deployment topology: our platform team is evaluating either a VPC-hosted private deployment in our AWS account or an on-prem air-gapped option for high-risk datasets. The items we need clarified for each path are: data egress controls, KMS/HSM integration, and how network isolation is handled (bastion, NAT, firewall rules).

Next steps I propose from our side: we’ll circulate the RFI across infra/security and send answers back within 5 business days. From Redwood, could you send a short checklist of required network diagrams and any standard template for private/VPC deployments? Also confirm what artifacts you can share now (redacted SOC2, encryption whitepaper, and a POC checklist).

Attachments: Novamed_Security_RFI_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 1 sheet)

--
Claire Park
Director, IT Security
Novamed Health
claire.park@novamed.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novamed.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 17:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private deploy options & compliance questions

Claire — really appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline and next steps.

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in March 2027; we can share a redacted report for procurement (SOC2_report_redacted.pdf). Full report requires an NDA / secure transfer.
- HIPAA: yes, we support HIPAA-covered workloads and will sign a BAA.
- GDPR/data residency: we support region-specific deployments (US / EU) and provide DPA language. For Private (VPC/on-prem) customers you can control region and residency.

On the private deployment checklist: attached is a lightweight draw.io template we use for incoming topology diagrams (redwood_private_deploy_template.drawio). To help your infra team prepare, please include: 
  * expected ingress endpoints and client IP ranges (CIDRs)
  * preferred cloud account (AWS account ID) or on-prem host inventory
  * storage and persistence choices (S3/EBS/NFS) and encryption-at-rest requirements
  * whether you require an air-gapped image delivery process
  * any network egress prohibitions (internet access blocked for model weights)

Regarding KMS/HSM: we integrate with customer-managed KMS for key wrapping and support HSMs for signing operations. For an air-gapped option, we can provide signed model bundles and an offline installer process.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You send back the RFI answers + an initial topology diagram using the attached template.
2) We schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with our deployment engineer (Ben) and solutions lead (Lauren) — available Tue/Wed next week.
3) We'll provide the redacted SOC2 and a POC acceptance checklist for your legal/procurement.

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_template.drawio (diagram template)

Thanks — I'll coordinate availability once you confirm preferred time windows.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
--
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Park <claire.park@novamed.com>, security@novamed.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private deploy options & compliance questions

Karthik — thanks for the clarity. A few answers from our infra/security side to help you prep: 

- SOC 2: we prefer vendors with a current Type II but can accept a redacted copy during evaluation.
- HIPAA: Yes, we are covered; BAA is required.
- Data residency: primary requirement is that PHI stays in US regions and backups must be in a separate controlled account.

Topology notes we’ll include in the RFI response:
- Our security team will provide two CIDR ranges for the VPC (10.10.0.0/16 for prod, 10.20.0.0/16 for staging) and a set of egress rules to block model weight downloads to public internet.
- For air-gap: we need an offline image delivery checksum + signed installer.
- Audit logs: must be shipped to our Splunk instance; support for syslog/HTTPS endpoints is required.

We attached the initial RFI (Novamed_Security_RFI_v1.xlsx) with answers in the first tab — it’s a partial draft. Expect the completed RFI and a topology diagram by EOD Tuesday.

Tom Reynolds
VP, Infrastructure
Novamed Health
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@novamed.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novamed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Private deploy options & compliance questions

Hi Claire / Tom — Lauren here (Solutions + Deploy). Thanks for the RFI draft and the CIDR notes, that’s exactly what we need to move the design forward. A few technical clarifications and what we’ll bring to the technical deep dive: 

Requested artifacts from Novamed for the deep dive (please attach ahead of the call):
- Topology diagram (use the provided draw.io template) with the two CIDR blocks and any transit VPCs
- List of hostnames/IPs that need to reach the inference endpoints (client CIDRs)
- Storage choice and expected TPS / concurrency profile for token throughput sizing

Redwood capabilities / commitments we’ll present:
- SOC 2: we will share a redacted SOC2 Type II (March 2027) during the procurement process.
- BAA: Redwood will sign. We have a standard HIPAA playbook for private deployments.
- KMS/HSM: integration via customer-managed KMS is supported; HSM key injection workflows are documented.
- Audit logs: we can stream request-level traces and audit events to your Splunk endpoint (syslog over TLS).
- Air-gapped option: offline signed model bundles, installer images delivered via secure transfer (SFTP with signed checksum).

POC acceptance criteria we suggest:
1) Network isolation: deployment is reachable only from the provided CIDRs and through a bastion host we jointly test.
2) Key management: customer-managed keys are used for model encryption; keys rotated during POC window.
3) Auditability: logs are successfully consumed by your Splunk instance for 48 hours.
4) Performance: 95th percentile tail latency within agreed SLO for a 32-token request profile.

Proposed slots for the 60-min technical deep dive (PST): Wed 2027-05-19 09:00 or 13:00. Ben will cover deployment packaging and network workarounds; I’ll cover operational runbook and acceptance tests.

We’ve attached a redacted SOC2 report for your procurement review (SOC2_report_redacted.pdf). If that looks good, we’ll follow with the full control-mapped artifact via secure transfer once the NDA is in place.

Attachments: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (redacted, PDF)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Principal Deployment Lead
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
